text: Given a fake Graph client returns an ipNamedLocation payload for a given location_id, When graph_list_named_locations is called with that location_id, Then the result's location_type is "ip" and it includes ipRanges and isTrusted unchanged from the fake response.

Given a fake Graph client returns a countryNamedLocation payload for a given location_id, When graph_list_named_locations is called with that location_id, Then the result's location_type is "country", it includes countriesAndRegions, and it does not fabricate an isTrusted key.

Given a fake Graph client returns a collection payload with two named locations, When graph_list_named_locations is called with no location_id, Then the request path has no id segment and the result contains both locations, each shaped with a location_type.

Given a fake Graph client's collection response includes an @odata.nextLink, When graph_list_named_locations is called with no location_id, Then the result's has_more is true and no more than the connector's cap worth of items are returned in one call.

Given a fake Graph client raises a 404 for a given location_id, When graph_list_named_locations is called with that id, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "not_found", ...}}, not an exception propagating out of the tool call.

Given no X-Ms-Graph-Token header (client_factory returns None), When graph_list_named_locations is called with or without location_id, Then the result equals the connector's NO_TOKEN envelope, unchanged from every other tool's behavior.

Given a real Entra ID tenant whose app registration has not been granted Policy.Read.All, When graph_list_named_locations is called against a real named location id, Then Graph's 403 surfaces as {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", ...}}.
steps: Use an Entra ID app registration/tenant where Policy.Read.All has not been granted (or has not been re-consented)
Call graph_list_named_locations with a valid-looking GUID as location_id
Inspect the raw HTTP response from ms-graph-mcp
expect: Response body is {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "message": ..., "retryable": false}}, not a stack trace or a 500.
evidence: needs a real vendor account / tenant in this specific consent state; not available during design. The underlying 401/403 -> unauthorized classification is pre-existing code in api_client.py, already exercised by other tools' tests, not new code introduced by this ticket.

text: Given graph_list_named_locations is registered with a README Tools-table row and a docs/gdap-role-map.yaml entry, When tests/test_gdap_role_map.py's existing consistency check runs, Then it passes without any modification to that test file.
